title: Heading of the admins' Settings › Access card about how people sign in to this server.
intro: Security wording, keep it precise. "The environment" is the server's configuration (environment variables set by whoever runs the server); it is the upper limit ("ceiling"): this page can only switch methods off and remove people or domains, never add them. "A stack update" means changing the server's deployment configuration.
unreadable: Error shown when the saved sign-in policy is corrupt; the server's configuration applies instead until an admin saves again.
version: Status line: {{version}} is the policy's version number; <when></when> is the date and time it was saved (keep the tags).
when: A date and time on this page; only formats it.
nothingNarrowed: Status line when no admin has narrowed sign-in yet, so the server's configuration applies as is.
methods.title: Legend over the checkboxes of sign-in methods.
methods.password: A sign-in method admins can switch off: signing in with an email address and a password.
methods.passkey: A sign-in method admins can switch off: passkeys (a credential stored on the person's device: fingerprint, face or PIN).
methods.signInLink: A sign-in method: a one-time link sent by the Telegram bot.
methods.emailLinks: A sign-in method: one-time codes and links sent by email.
methods.emailLinksHelp: Help text under the email codes and links sign-in method in Settings › Access: when on, sign-in codes and links are emailed to every account; it is off unless an admin turns it on.
methods.offIn: Badge next to a sign-in method the server's configuration turned off, so it can't be turned on here. {{env}} is an environment variable name such as AUTH_PASSWORD (never translated). The _telegram form: the Telegram bot isn't set up. The _email form: this server has no email channel.
methods.openSignUp: A sign-in setting: anyone may create their own account, without an invitation.
lists.ceiling: Follows each list's help text. {{env}} is an environment variable name such as AUTH_ALLOWED_EMAILS (never translated). "Untick": clear the checkbox.
lists.empty: Shown when a list is empty in the server's configuration; {{env}} is the environment variable's name.
lists.providers: Legend of the list of OAuth / OpenID Connect sign-in providers (such as Google or GitHub).
lists.providersHelp: Help text under the list of sign-in providers: the OAuth and OpenID Connect providers (such as Google or GitHub) offered on the sign-in screen. OAuth and OpenID Connect are standard names; don't translate them.
lists.adminEmails: Legend of the list of email addresses that are always admins.
lists.adminEmailsHelp: Help text under the list of email addresses that are always admins: removing one makes that person an ordinary member at their next request, unless their own role is admin.
lists.allowedEmails: Legend of the list of email addresses allowed to create an account.
lists.allowedEmailsHelp: Help text under the list of allowed email addresses: the people who may create their own account by signing in through a provider (such as Google).
lists.allowedDomains: Legend of the list of email domains (such as example.com) whose people may create an account.
lists.allowedDomainsHelp: Help text under the list of allowed email domains (such as example.com): people with an address there may create their own account by signing in through a provider.
mockAuth: "The local picker (mock auth)" is the development sign-in that lists test users; there are no real sign-in methods.
codeAccess: <link>People → Groups</link> links to the Groups tab of Settings › People (keep the tags; match those pages' names in your language).
review: Button that opens the confirmation dialog for the pending changes.
undo: Button that discards the pending, unsaved changes on this page.
impact.sessionsEnded: Preview of a pending change: how many signed-in sessions it will end.
impact.signsYouOut: Preview of a pending change: the admin making it will be signed out too.
impact.withoutWayIn: Preview of a pending change: the people who will have no sign-in method left. {{people}} is a list of people, each "name (email)".
impact.person: One person in the list of people left without a way to sign in: their name and email.
impact.codeRunsStopped: Preview of a pending change: how many queued or running code runs (sandboxed code jobs) it will stop.
confirm.description: Security wording: every sign-in change requires the admin to prove it is them again (a step-up), and every admin is notified.
confirm.withConfirm: Button on development servers without real accounts: confirms without a password or passkey.
confirm.saved: Toast after the sign-in policy was saved; every admin was notified.
history.label: Screen-reader label of the list of past changes to the sign-in policy.
history.entry: A past change: <when></when> is its date and time (keep the tags), {{actor}} the name of who made it.
history.confirmed: Follows a past change's author: how they confirmed it. {{method}} is the step-up method's identifier; the contexts are password, passkey, confirm (the development sign-in's confirmation) and cli (the server's command line).
history.sessionsEnded: After a past change's description: how many sessions it ended.
history.codeRunsStopped: After a past change's description: how many code runs it stopped.
errors.start: Shown in the confirmation dialog when the server couldn't start the confirmation (step-up).
errors.check: Shown when the preview of a pending change's effects failed.
methods.google: A sign-in method admins switch on or off: people sign in with a Google account they linked, in the Socio mobile app and on the workspace's website. "Google" is a brand name.
methods.googleHelp: Help text under the Google sign-in method: it works for people who linked a Google account, in the Socio mobile app or on this website, while the server is connected to Socio's cloud services. "Google" is a brand name.
methods.apple: A sign-in method admins switch on or off: people sign in with an Apple account they linked (Sign in with Apple), in the Socio mobile app and on the workspace's website. "Apple" is a brand name.
methods.appleHelp: Help text under the Apple sign-in method: it works for people who linked an Apple account, in the Socio mobile app or on this website, while the server is connected to Socio's cloud services. "Apple" is a brand name.
methods.offIn_cloud: Badge on a sign-in method this server can't offer now: it needs the server's connection to Socio's cloud services.
confirm.title: Title of the dialog where the admin proves it is them (password or passkey) before a sign-in change saves.
confirm.password: Label of the password field in the confirmation dialog: the admin's own password.
confirm.withPassword: Button in the confirmation dialog: confirms the change with the password typed above.
confirm.withPasskey: Button in the confirmation dialog: confirms the change with one of the admin's passkeys.
confirm.cancel: Button that closes the confirmation dialog without saving the change.
history.title: Heading of the list of past changes to the sign-in policy, at the bottom of Settings › Access.
history.empty: Shown in the History list when the sign-in policy was never changed.
errors.load: Toast when the Settings › Access page couldn't load the server's sign-in policy (shown when the server gives no reason).
errors.save: Error in the confirmation dialog when the sign-in change could not be saved.
